app.title: Great Expeditions
app.tagline: Race the great explorers across the old world map. Every step forward is earned with geography.
app.credits: Map data: Natural Earth (public domain). Country data: mledoze/countries (ODbL). Flags: flag-icons (MIT).

setup.name: Name
setup.invalid: Every player needs a name and a different explorer.
level.beginner.desc: Beginner: well-known countries, capitals and flags; famous rivers and mountains as multiple choice.
level.intermediate.desc: Intermediate: every country of a region, less familiar capitals and flags, major rivers, lakes and ranges on the map.
level.advanced.desc: Advanced: small states, islands, smaller rivers and ranges, similar-looking flags and harder geographical facts.
level.expert.desc: Expert: obscure features, the trickiest flags and historical-geography questions.
howto.title: How to play
howto.1: Each round, every explorer picks a risk: Scout (+1 step), Navigator (+2) or Pathfinder (+3), then answers a geography question about the region they are in.
howto.2: Wrong answers let your threat close in. On map questions, clicking a neighbouring country is a near miss: a smaller move and no penalty.
howto.3: Your threat moves every round. If it catches you, you lose a life and go back to your last unlocked checkpoint.
howto.4: Checkpoints and landmarks ask history and culture questions. They never move you, but they unlock respawn points, lives, items and shelter.
howto.5: Forks offer the route the expedition really took (sealed) or a real alternative of the time. Choose wisely: the journal tells what really happened.
howto.6: Every third round is a Crossroads: one shared question, first correct answer wins +2 steps and an item. Buzz with Q, P, Z or M.
howto.7: Reach the destination and solve the Final Expedition Challenge to win.
